{"metadata":{"description":"Deterministic, zero-LLM, byte-budget context compaction for DeepSeek Harness, with byte-exact recall of compacted history","id":"gh:1389659204","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-hypercompact","slug":"mrbeandev/dsh-hypercompact","topics":["compaction","context-compression","context-window","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","llm","plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Deterministic, zero-LLM, byte-budget context compaction for DeepSeek Harness, with byte-exact recall"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" of compacted history"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-hypercompact"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Deterministic, zero-LLM, byte-budget context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (DSH),
with byte-exact "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"recall of everything it compacts."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"- **Source code:** github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-hypercompact
- **npm package:** npmjs.com/package/dsh-hy"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" code:** github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-hypercompact
- **npm package:** npmjs.com/package/dsh-hypercompact"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Long DSH sessions eventually fail because every request re-uploads the whole
conversation. dsh-hyper"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"compact keeps that request small: when it grows past a
byte limit, it compacts old history locally i"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"n milliseconds, with no extra model
call. Everything you typed stays word for word, and the agent ca"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"n restore any
compacted tool output exactly with the `recall` tool."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**Contents:** Supported DSH versions · Installation ·
Preset not in the picker? · Check that it is w"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"orking ·
Which sessions use it? · Uninstall ·
Why this plugin exists · Configuration ·
How it works "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"· Recall tools ·
Requirements · Known limits"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why this plugin exists"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Every model call in a long agent session re-uploads the whole conversation. On a
slow or proxied con"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"nection the request **body size**, not the token count, is
what fails: a 20 MB request can take minu"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"tes to upload and hit a proxy's
100-second timeout before the model ever sees it. DSH then retries t"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"he same
oversized request."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The built-in engine (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`) cannot help there:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- it triggers on a fraction of the model's context window, which a 1M-token
model may never reach ev"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"en while the body is far too large to upload;
- it summarizes by sending the whole history to an LLM"},{"id":"p10s3","text":", which is the same
oversized upload that is already failing."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"dsh-hypercompact measures the next request in **bytes** and compacts locally in
milliseconds, with n"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"o model call. Measured on real sessions, inline screenshots
were 50–92 % of the request body, and to"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ol traffic most of the rest. The plugin
targets both."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **What you wrote is never cut.** Every human message stays verbatim in the
checkpoint, through any"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" number of later compactions. Your constraints
("never …", "do not …", "only …") are pinned at the t"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"op. The same protection
covers a parent agent's task prompt in a subagent session, `/goal` round
pro"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"mpts, and team messages.
- **Old tool calls collapse to one line each:** tool name, key arguments, a"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"
`+N/−M lines` summary for edits, and a pointer to the original. Runs of
read-only calls (`read ×7: "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"a.js b.js …`) become one line.
- **Old tool results collapse** to status, size, a short head/tail ex"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"cerpt, and
a pointer. Failed results keep a larger excerpt.
- **State of work.** A block lists the l"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"ast files edited, the last commands, and
unresolved errors.
- **Images.** Older inline images become"},{"id":"p13s9","text":" text labels, captioned with what the
assistant said about them.
- **Housekeeping.** Between the tar"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"get and the trigger, a light pass trims old
tool results in place instead of rewriting history.
- **"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"Recall.** The model gets `recall`, which restores any original
**byte-exact** from the append-only s"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"ession log (or just the matching lines of
a large one), plus `recall_search`. You get `/recall` and "},{"id":"p13s13","text":"`/hypercompact`.
- **Drop-in.** It implements the public `ctx.compaction` contract, so
`/compact`, t"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"he token meter and context charts keep working. No client bundle,
no settings UI, no patching of har"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"and context charts keep working. No client bundle,
no settings UI, no patching of harness internals."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Why these defaults"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **5 MB trigger.** On a slow uplink (100–250 KB/s), 5 MB uploads in about
20–50 s, inside the commo"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"n 100 s proxy/CDN timeout even at the low end.
- **1.5 MB target.** About 6–15 s per request after c"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ompaction, with 3.5 MB of
growth before the next compaction (each compaction is one cache miss).
- *"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"*`retainTurns: 2`, `retainBytes: 400000`.** The current and previous turn stay
verbatim, so the agen"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"t never loses the work in progress.
- **`contextRatio: 0.85`.** A token safety net for a small-windo"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"w model whose
session stays under the byte trigger.
- **`keepRecentImages: 2`.** The screenshots the"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" agent is currently looking at
survive, and older ones, the dominant cost in measured sessions, do n"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ot.
- **`minCheckpointBytes: 300000`.** Measured: with a smaller floor, sessions
whose retained tail"},{"id":"p15s9","text":" is image-heavy got a tiny budget and elided hundreds of
entries; at 300 KB every measured session c"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"ompiled with degradation ≤ 1 and
nothing elided, while still landing near the 1.5 MB target."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"On a fast connection with a large-window model you can raise both byte values
(for example 20 MB → 6"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" MB); the token trigger still protects the context window."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Per-model policies.** None ship by default, because provider and model IDs are
deployment-specific"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"; `provider` and `model` must match your route exactly:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Trigger.** Before every model step (`agent/pre-step`), the engine estimates
the next request body:"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" each surface message serialized as JSON, inline images
as base64, plus the tool schemas and a fixed"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" envelope. Per-message sizes are
cached by log seq and the log is folded incrementally, so a step co"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"sts
O(new events), not a rescan of the session. It compacts when the estimate
reaches `maxRequestByt"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"es`, or when a token trigger fires."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Selection.** It replaces the oldest span of the surface. The span never
includes the system prompt"},{"id":"p21s2","text":", never cuts between an assistant tool call and its
results, prefers turn boundaries, and never touc"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"hes the newest `retainTurns`
turns or `retainBytes` bytes. It compacts enough that the result lands "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"near
`targetRequestBytes`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Checkpoint.** The span is compiled into one user message with three parts:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.5-rc.2` up to (not including) `0.3.0`. See
Supported DSH versions for the te"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"sted versions and
what happens outside the range.
- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` (whatever your "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"DSH runs on).
- Any profile with an agent-preset roster (the web profile). The headless
profile has "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"no preset roster; see Add it to a preset by hand."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The plugin has no runtime dependencies. At mount time it loads
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction`, `dsh-l"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"lm` and `dsh-tools` from the **running** DSH,
never from a second copy, so the engine subclasses the"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" host's own
`CompactionEngine`."}],"truncated":true}
